notes.title: Version 1.35 Released!
notes.notes:
This is a maintenance fix for Streets of Chaos that has a few important fixes and changes. 

- FIX: Corrected a bug that could sometimes cause the game to crash when fighting your secret enemy and losing.
- FIX: Fixed a rare bug that would cause streets to get 'stuck' where you couldn't access them anymore if you had both guys get arrested while taking them over.
- TWEAK: Eliminated the random event where one of your gang would die suddenly for no reason. This will lessen the random nature of the game somewhat and allow players to use their gang more strategically.
- TWEAK: Increased the chance of Pawn Shop items having two abilities slightly.
- TWEAK: Refactored the code a bit to increase speed 4% overall.

Thanks and enjoy!
Derek

notes.title: Version 1.1 Update released!
notes.notes:
Streets of Chaos had a quick 1.1 update released today, with some very cool changes. These include:

- By popular demand, a newly added tutorial is now in the game!
- A 'Challenge' mode with special game conditions that can be chosen at the start, including starting at 20 HQ instead of 40, no access to weapons, and more! These should really make the game a challenge for those more experienced with the game.
- Made the early game a bit easier by increasing your starting cash to $2,000 and starting resources by 10 each, and the ending game a bit tougher by increasing the cost of Police Bribing to prevent abuse later in the game.
- Tweaked the frequency of negative random events slightly in the early going to give you a little more setup time.
- Fixed one very rare bug that "locked up" a map square under certain conditions if a guy got arrested while taking over a street.

Have fun!
Derek

notes.title: Tech/Game Update!
notes.notes:
After dozens of email conversations with various gamers (many of who have been very supportive of the game - thank you!), i've now made a change to the game's install setup to "integrate" it more with Steam. 

It now streams many of the game's assets through Steam directly (jncluding the game .exe) and only runs a small stub the first time you run it to install a few fonts and required support/config files. After that, the game should run through Steam normally using the "Play" button. This should also allow tracking of time played, which in turn should allow reviews.

All I request is that you please play the game a little while before posting a review. The game is intended to be a fun little strategy game, not an massive opus, nor a derivative or copy of any other game, including Chaos Overlords.

If you wish to see the game reviewed by fellow Steam user Zaxtor99, visit our Videos section for an excellent 4-video series that explains the game very well.

Thanks and enjoy!
Derek
